title: PF2e Campaign Ledger
description: Long-term table statistics for Pathfinder 2e: attacks, crits, damage dealt and taken, healing, kills, downed and dying, saves, skills, spells, natural 20s and 1s, rerolls and Hero Points. Grouped by session, arc and encounter, viewed in a dashboard window, with reset, export and a read-only player view. Ending a session can archive the chat log with it and clear the chat, so long campaigns stay quick; the GM reads archived chat from the Sessions tab.
